items.summary: Many direct-to-patient programs have significantly affected access to medicines, a survey of U.S. life sciences leaders found.

items.title: Alcon ponies up $550M for Neurotech, bagging approved cell therapy implant Encelto
items.summary: Eye specialty pharma Alcon has bought out Neurotech Pharmaceuticals for $550 million, gaining access to the approved Encelto and Neurotech's proprietary cell-based gene therapy delivery platform.

items.title: New US drug launches need price check to counter access impediments, ICER, West Health urge
items.summary: As policies from the last two presidential administrations put heightened focus on drug affordability in the United States, a new report suggests much work remains to be done when it comes to the launch prices of novel medicines.

items.title: CSL taps GSK’s Deborah Waterhouse as CEO in darkest hour
items.summary: Recruiting an industry veteran to steer the company through its darkest hour of growth pressures, CSL has hired GSK’s Deborah Waterhouse as its next CEO.

items.title: AI-Powered Brand Sites Are Changing Patient Engagement
items.summary: Compliant AI helps brands answer patient questions in real time and turn conversations into actionable insights.

items.title: GSK brings promise of 'functional cure' to hepatitis B finish line with FDA nod for Hibsago
items.summary: With the FDA’s green light in hepatitis B, GSK and its Ionis-licensed medicine bepirovirsen have racked up several notable distinctions, bringing the antisense oligonucleotide class to bear against the virus for the first time alongside the promise of functional cure-standard efficacy versus pre-existing treatments.

items.title: FDA solidifies stance on mobile apps, software used with prescription drugs in final guidance
items.summary: The agency clarified its framework for when drugmakers should include prescription drug apps in their labeling submissions or when app content should instead be treated as promotional material.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: Viatris' Ryzumvi wins FDA nod in age-related vision loss
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: CDMO Samsung Bio wins temporary reprieve from strike threat after Seoul court ruling
items.summary: Ahead of a planned strike by its labor union later this month, Samsung Biologics has secured a favorable South Korean court ruling that shields most of its drug substance manufacturing operations from the labor action.

items.title: Antheia lands $80M conditional loan from Trump administration to onshore drug manufacturing
items.summary: The Department of War is allotting a conditional $80 million loan to next-gen ingredient maker Antheia, a move that will give the U.S. critical access to key starting materials and active pharmaceutical ingredients that are almost exclusively produced overseas.

items.title: Cosette lands FDA approval for Evoxac liquid in Sjögren’s disease
items.summary: The approval is for a liquid formulation of Evoxac, which was originally marketed by Daiichi Sankyo in capsules, providing an alternative treatment option for managing dry mouth symptoms in patients living with Sjögren’s disease.

items.title: AbbVie hits the gas on immunology awareness with McLaren F1 pact
items.summary: AbbVie has formed a multiyear deal with the McLaren Formula 1 team, signing up to raise awareness of immune-mediated diseases and provide funding for global charities.

items.title: Veradermics' hot streak continues with another phase 3 win in hair loss
items.summary: Topline results show the biotech's lead asset, VDPHL01, cleared all primary and secondary endpoints in a study of more than 500 men with mild-to-moderate pattern hair loss.

items.title: Amgen, AZ dive deep into Tezspire's Dupixent-challenging victory in EoE phase 3
items.summary: With little time elapsed since AstraZeneca and Amgen unveiled a topline win for Tezspire over the summer, the partners are upping the stakes with a detailed look at their inflammation-fighting antibody’s prowess in eosinophilic esophagitis.

items.title: GSK’s Jemperli scores FDA approval in rectal cancer, backed by high complete response rate
items.summary: Building on the buzz around a celebrated early trial readout, GSK’s Jemperli has earned a first-in-class FDA approval in a specific type of rectal cancer.

items.title: EyePoint cuts headcount, shifts priorities after another Duravyu AMD miss
items.summary: In new topline results, EyePoint disclosed that its tyrosine kinase inhibitor Duravyu performed worse than Eylea in patients with wet AMD, compelling the pharma to drop its program in the indication and make significant staff cuts.
